gen-gf-goldman-bitter: Wide-set and bold, Goldman spaces its letters generously and rounds its forms like open parentheses across the top line. Bitter, a slab-serif with a see-through s, grounds everything below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-lexend-peta: Press Start 2P brings retro, stencil-cut letters pinned far apart, with only a faint hint of varied bar width up close. Lexend Peta then reads smoothly, its marker-like line never thinning.
gen-gf-goldman-rubik: Brash and wide, Goldman rounds its letters like open parentheses. Rubik is the soft sans-serif of the two, built for clear reading at small sizes while Goldman handles the loud first impression.
gen-gf-grandstander-bitter: Expressive and bold, Grandstander keeps constant-width lines and holds its letters open, with short ascenders over a tall x-height. Bitter, a slab-serif with big lowercase eyes, makes paragraphs feel grounded.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-bitter: Expressive and bold, Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height and points its terminals outward. Bitter, the slab-serif, is the grounded half, its see-through s keeping things dependable.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-inter: Inter, with smooth tube-like lines and big counters, lets Love Ya Like A Sister do the shouting. The heading's level beat and outward-pointing terminals stand out against the smooth body.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-cascadia-mono: Luckiest Guy is loud and cheerful, with a mean line set high. Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, curves matching the straight stems, keeping the text modern beneath it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-inter: A high-set midline and soft fat-to-slim strokes mark Metamorphous as the commanding voice here. And Inter, whose curves and straights share a single width and whose counters breathe, keeps reading smooth.
gen-righteous-gf-lexend-tera: Righteous fills the line with big bowls, like thin steel rod bent into every letter. And it earns its keep big and short, while Lexend Tera spaces its single-weight letters like stepping stones.
gen-gf-oxanium-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open-throated letters and a dense middle zone, sits beneath the monoline Oxanium. Text there feels precise and structured, with a tidy density line after line.
